svg.title: Three optional Whisper language modes
svg.desc: Indian English, Hindi-English and Bengali-English are selectable for short live requests with optional Whisper packs. Auto is also available. Real-speech accuracy remains under evaluation.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Optional Whisper Small or Turbo packs, including Turbo with an unquantized decoder · Auto also available · Live accuracy remains under evaluation
